preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Reporte BCR'

insert.column: SELECT CAST(l.account_no AS VARCHAR) AS "No Prestamo", ( SELECT dr.classification FROM m_loan_delinquency_tag_history dth JOIN m_delinquency_range dr ON dr.id = dth.delinquency_range_id WHERE dth.loan_id = l.id AND dth.liftedon_date IS NULL ORDER BY dth.addedon_date DESC, dth.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS "Clsf", c.display_name AS "Nombre", ROUND(l.approved_principal, 2) AS "Monto Aprobado", l.disbursedon_date AS "Fecha Otorga.", l.expected_maturedon_date AS "Fecha Venci.", ( SELECT MAX(lt.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction lt WHERE lt.loan_id = l.id AND lt.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND lt.is_reversed = FALSE AND lt.transaction_date <= '${endDate}' ) AS "Ultimo Pago", ROUND(l.net_disbursal_amount, 2) AS "Monto Desemb.", ROUND(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 2) AS "Saldo", l.number_of_repayments AS "Plazo", ROUND(l.annual_nominal_interest_rate, 2) AS "Tasa % Interes", ROUND(COALESCE(( SELECT rs.principal_amount + rs.interest_amount FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_id = l.id ORDER BY rs.installment LIMIT 1 ), 0), 2) AS "Cuota K+I", ROUND(COALESCE(( SELECT rs.principal_amount + rs.interest_amount + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_id = l.id ORDER BY rs.installment LIMIT 1 ), 0), 2) AS "Cuota Total", ROUND(GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(l.net_disbursal_amount, 0), 0), 2) AS "Cargos Desembolso", ROUND(COALESCE(( SELECT rs.fee_charges_amount FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_id = l.id ORDER BY rs.installment LIMIT 1 ), 0), 2) AS "Cargos Cuota", l.tea AS "TEA %", l.tea_maxima AS "TEA % Maxima", CASE WHEN l.tea IS NULL OR l.tea_maxima IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN l.tea <= l.tea_maxima THEN 'CUMPLE' ELSE 'NO CUMPLE' END AS "Cumplimiento" FROM m_loan l JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = c.office_id JOIN m_product_loan p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN m_office selected_office ON selected_office.id = ${officeId} WHERE l.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL AND l.disbursedon_date >= '${startDate}' AND l.disbursedon_date <= '${endDate}' AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(selected_office.hierarchy, '%') AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') AND ('${currencyId}' = '-1' OR l.currency_code = '${currencyId}') AND (${loanProductId} = -1 OR l.product_id = ${loanProductId}) AND ( '${slu}' = '-1' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_product_loan_slu pls JOIN crd_slu s ON s.id_slu = pls.id_slu WHERE pls.product_loan_id = p.id AND s.activo = TRUE AND s.slu = '${slu}' ) ) ORDER BY l.account_no

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter (report_id, parameter_id, report_parameter_name) SELECT sr.id, params.parameter_id, params.parameter_name FROM stretchy_report sr CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS parameter_id, 'startDate' AS parameter_name UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'endDate' UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'officeId' UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'currencyId' UNION ALL SELECT 25, 'loanProductId' UNION ALL SELECT id, 'slu' FROM stretchy_parameter WHERE parameter_name = 'BcrSluSelectAll' ) params WHERE sr.report_name = 'Reporte BCR';
